purpose: Known-case material choices diagnostic only; preserve contradictions; no new rule, classification, refit, rating analysis or validation claim.
retry_policy: No retries, no threshold tuning. Save unknown/incomplete evidence.
history: Reconstruct exact full original PGN history; verify before and after FEN and played move. Fresh UCI game token and Clear Hash for every query.
query_order: before restricted to no immediate offer roots, MultiPV1, unless rootset empty
before played-only MultiPV1 if actual move absent from current unrestricted top4, or current window unknown
snapshot_method: Small local implementation of collector same-depth complete-window logic generalized to count and root_moves; retain last two complete depth windows.
rootset: All legal roots tested using original augment-pv.qualify(before,after). No immediate offer means no qualifying profitable immediate nonpawn capture; unknown qualifier roots excluded and explicitly recorded. This does not guarantee preservation: checks may postpone a threat.
qualifier: Opponent legal nonpawn/nonking captures: net same-square exchange gain > immediate mover material credit +100; original512-node offer budget.
score: White and mover oriented cp or mate, no forced cp conversion for mates; contexts differ across unrestricted and constrained searches.
pv: Full returned legal SAN/UCI PV and per-ply FEN, terminal status. Finite nonterminal lines remain truncated, not material outcome claims.
